title: Claims Manual — Figuring a Loss-of-Use Payment and Its Late-Payment Interest, Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)
content:
On an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** claim the amount of a loss-of-use payment is figured as follows.

## Clause

The claim is the claim of the policy that carries the latest adjuster report, and every claim figure is read from that claim's own entries. The loss of use counted is the figure incurred to date on the latest adjuster report of the claim. The loss-of-use payable is the loss of use counted, never more than the tier's loss-of-use limit, and the new loss-of-use payment is the loss-of-use payable less the loss-of-use payments already issued on the claim net of voided ones, issued only when positive, rounded to the cent once at the end. Late-payment interest is the new loss-of-use payment times the yearly interest rate times the interest days over 365, the yearly interest rate being 8 percent. The interest days are the days after the due date, which is the tier's claim-payment days after the later of the latest proof of loss on the claim and the latest underlying settlement record of the claim, and there are none where neither is on file or the due date has not passed.

The amount issued is the new loss-of-use payment with the late-payment interest added last, rounded to the cent once at the end. The date of loss is the one recorded at first notice of the claim; the payment date is the day the payment is issued. Where two entries on a file share the date they are read by, or two policy records answer the same description, the one entered first is read.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, not a tier's)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Loss of use incurred to date on the latest adjuster report | 46000.00 |
| Loss-of-use limit (hypothetical) | 40000.00 |
| Loss-of-use payable | 40000.00 |
| Loss-of-use payments issued 18000.00, of which 3000.00 voided | 15000.00 net |
| New loss-of-use payment | 25000.00 |
| Latest proof of loss 50 days before payment; latest underlying settlement record 40 days before; claim-payment period 30 days | due 10 days before payment, 10 interest days |
| Interest: 25000.00 times 8 percent times 10 over 365 | 54.79 |
| Amount issued | 25054.79 |

Had neither a proof of loss nor an underlying settlement record been on file, there would be no interest days and the amount issued would be 25000.00.
